summaryEvents.text: The USB-B plug matches the rail-mounted socket. Calibration is complete; the agent checks clearance and approach height.
One wrist view shows the tip beside the socket. The agent withdraws before correcting the offset.
The tip is in front of the socket. Contact and centering checks continue; entry is not yet confirmed.
Both wrist views confirm entry. The agent begins alignment and checks engagement after each adjustment.
The connector remains engaged and has advanced. A rotation that increased bending load has been reversed; alignment continues.
